description: Source code for a FastAPI application that streams a PNG image in various ways, including async and sync methods, with different endpoint configurations.

classes.name: PNGStreamingResponse
classes.description: Custom StreamingResponse class with media_type set to 'image/png'.

methods.name: read_image
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded PNG image and returns a BytesIO stream.

methods.name: stream_image
methods.description: Async generator that yields image chunks from the BytesIO stream.

methods.name: stream_image_no_async
methods.description: Synchronous generator that yields image chunks.

methods.name: stream_image_no_async_yield_from
methods.description: Synchronous generator using 'yield from' to yield image chunks.

methods.name: stream_image_no_annotation
methods.description: Async function similar to 'stream_image' but without explicit response annotation.

methods.name: stream_image_no_async_no_annotation
methods.description: Synchronous function similar to 'stream_image_no_async' but without explicit response annotation.
